findings.title: postMessage handler without origin validation
findings.detail: 2 `message` listener(s) present in this asset with no `event.origin` comparison detected — cross-window messages from any origin will be trusted.
findings.remediation: Validate `event.origin` against an explicit allowlist before reading `event.data`. For wallet UIs this is a common takeover vector.

findings.title: Missing CAA record
findings.detail: No CAA record on kuru.io. Any CA can issue certificates for this domain.
findings.remediation: Publish CAA restricting issuance to your CA(s), e.g. letsencrypt.org.

findings.title: Exposed secret: walletconnect_project_id
findings.detail: Pattern `walletconnect_project_id` matched in a client-shipped asset. Anything reachable from the browser is public.
findings.remediation: Rotate the credential immediately, remove it from the client bundle, and move to a server-side proxy or short-lived signed tokens if the key must be reachable from the browser.

findings.title: HSTS missing includeSubDomains
